title: Shipment Exception Checklist
subtitle: Shipment Exception: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Shipment Exception Checklist covers shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action. The shipment exception coordinator records Shipment Exception criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Shipment Exception Checklist keeps Shipment Exception exceptions visible until the shipment exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Shipment Exception Checklist at origin, in-transit node, destination, vehicle, and recovery location. Document shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action identity before Shipment Exception begins. Compare shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action findings with stated Shipment Exception criteria; route unresolved Shipment Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Shipment Exception Checklist, confirm requirements for Shipment Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Shipment Exception conditions beyond the shipment exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Shipment Exception, identify responsible parties, origin, in-transit node, destination, vehicle, and recovery location, and the linked shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action source.

fields.label: Shipment, order, tracking, and service level
Affected item, piece, lot, serial, and quantity

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Shipment Exception facts for shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Shipment Exception inspection checks
items: Containment, reroute, recovery, or return action
Notice, owner, target, and final service outcome

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Shipment Exception evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Shipment Exception Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Condition or quantity cannot be established
blocks.guidance: Pause Shipment Exception when location, custody, condition, customer communication, or authorized recovery remains unresolved. Retain the available Shipment Exception proof and route unresolved shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action scope to shipment exception coordinator.
